m1.label: 1. Men and boys wouldn't have had all the best roles...
m1.why: This pairs with ‘if girls and women had been allowed to act in plays’ — only men and boys could act in Shakespeare's time.

m2.label: 2. If the Globe hadn't been built with wood,...
m2.why: This pairs with ‘it wouldn't have burnt down’ — the wooden Globe burned down in a real fire.

m3.label: 3. They could have used electric lights...
m3.why: This pairs with ‘if they had had electricity’ — electricity didn't exist in Tudor times.

m4.label: 4. The Globe wouldn't have been so popular...
m4.why: This pairs with ‘if it hadn't been so cheap’ — cheap tickets made the theatre popular.

m5.label: 5. If the theatre had had a roof,...
m5.why: This pairs with ‘people could have stayed dry when it rained’ — the Globe was open-air.

m6.label: 6. If they hadn't had pictures of the old Globe,...
m6.why: This pairs with ‘they couldn't have rebuilt it so well in the 1990s’ — old pictures helped the accurate rebuild.
